jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Technical Superintendent or maritime engineer with a passion for inland shipping, vessel management, and technical operations? Do you speak German fluently and enjoy working closely with crews and shipyards?
 

This is your opportunity to take a key role in managing a modern inland fleet in the Antwerp region.
 

Your Role as Technical Superintendent
 

As a Technical Superintendent Inland Shipping, you are responsible for the technical performance, maintenance, and reliability of the fleet. You act as the crucial link between crew, suppliers, and management.
 

Key responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Monitor the technical condition and operational performance of vessels 
 
• Plan and coordinate maintenance, repairs, and inspections 
 
• Visit vessels regularly (2–3 times per week) 
 
• Provide technical support to crews and build strong working relationships 
 
• Handle technical incidents and breakdowns (on-call rotation) 
 
• Manage and execute technical projects, refits, and upgrades 
 
• Develop and follow up on preventive maintenance plans (PMS) 
 
• Maintain contact with shipyards, suppliers, and classification societies 
 
• Manage the technical budget and advise on long-term investments 

Your Profile:
 
 
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Technology, Electromechanics, or Engineering 
 
• Proven experience as a Technical Superintendent / Vessel Manager (preferably inland shipping) 
 
• Fluent in German and English (mandatory requirement) 
 
• Knowledge of ship engines, propulsion systems, and electrical installations 
 
• Experience with PMS systems and technical documentation 
 
• Familiar with classification rules and maritime regulations 
 
• Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mentality 
 
• Excellent communicator, able to connect with technical teams and crew 
 
• Flexible and willing to travel frequently

jobs.occupation: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

Unique Antwerp Maritime is looking for a Crew Planner. You will be working for one of our clients, one of the largest offshore pipeline installation and subsea construction companies, located in Essen.
 

In this role, you will take full responsibility for crew planning within your assigned disciplines. You ensure everything runs smoothly — from long-term workforce planning to last-minute solutions.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 
 
• Creating and managing crew schedules for personnel on board our vessels 
 
• Acting as the point of contact for superintendents, captains, and shore-based colleagues 
 
• Collaborating closely with HR, Operations, and the crew members themselves 
 
• Taking into account experience, certifications, and project requirements 
 
• Identifying shortages or surpluses in staffing and contributing to solutions 
 
• Ensuring a fair distribution of experience and opportunities within teams 
 
• Discussing career growth and development opportunities for crew members together with HR 
 

In short: you maintain oversight in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

What matters to us? Your curiosity, drive, and enjoyment of what you do. It’s a big plus if you also bring:
 
 

• At least 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role, such as crew planning or transport planning 

• The ability to stay calm and maintain an overview, even when everything happens at once 

• Clear and friendly communication skills, with a good sense of humor 

• The confidence to make decisions and take responsibility, always with respect and situational awareness 

• Fluency in spoken and written English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus 

• A willingness to travel occasionally, for example to vessels or our office in Delft

As an 
Accountant at PRG, you'll play a vital role in our financial operations, 
supporting multiple entities, 
Belgium, Netherlands and France, and helping ensure smooth day-to-day processes.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Managing accounts receivable (AR) & payable (AP) 

• Handling intercompany invoicing for AR & AP 

• Creating and maintaining customer and supplier records in the ERP system 

• Following up on overdue payments of AR & AP 

• Posting bank statements

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of precision, adaptability, and strong communication. Ideally, you have:

• 2 to 3 years of experience, preferably in an international environment 

• Strong administrative and organizational skills 

• A client-focused mindset and team spirit 

• Fluency in Dutch and/or French, with a good command of English 

• Familiarity with ERP systems and Microsoft 365 (experience with Oracle is a plus)

This international company specializes in the production and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, including injection-moulded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machine park.

You will work in a two-shift system:
	
• Early shift: 06:00–14:00	
• Late shift: 14:00–22:00
As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your expertise, production processes remain reliable and downtime is kept to a minimum.

Your tasks and responsibilities
	
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.	
• Troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.	
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical breakdowns.	
• Analysing faults and looking for sustainable solutions.	
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.	
• Actively contributing to optimizations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machine park.	
• Working closely with the production department to minimize downtime.	
• Working according to applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.	
• Helping to maintain a clean, safe and well-organized working environment.

You have a strong technical background and enjoy working hands-on.

In addition, you have:
	
• A technical qualification in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, Automation or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.	
• Experience in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery.	
• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.	
• Basic knowledge of PLC control systems is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to develop this knowledge internally.	
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but is not required.	
• A good command of Dutch.	
• The ability to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.	
• Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.	
• A hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.	
• Good team spirit combined with the ability to carry out interventions independently.

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.
 

Your main responsibilities:
 
 

• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air 

• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE) 

• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...) 

• Receiving and processing customs documents 

• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint) 

• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests 

• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status 

• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team 

Who are you?
 
 
 
• Minimum A2 diploma  
 
• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role 
 
• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes 
 
• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems 
 
• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset 
 
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing 
 
• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator 
 
• Able to work independently and manage priorities
